# NAGA Law Chambers

> Law practice of Advocate S. Nagendra Naik at the Anantapur Bar, Andhra Pradesh, India. Direct advocacy in revenue and land matters before Tahsildar, RDO and Collector offices, plus civil, criminal, family and consumer cases in courts across Andhra Pradesh, including the Andhra Pradesh High Court.

## Facts

- Advocate: S. Nagendra Naik, B.A., LL.B.
- Practising at the Anantapur Bar since 2019; enrolled with the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in 2019.
- Areas served: all of Andhra Pradesh, from chambers in Anantapur.
- Office: Sub Registrar Office, Revenue Colony, Kovur Nagar, Opp. Ramnagar Park, Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh 515004, India.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 2 PM and 6 PM to 8 PM; closed on Sunday.
- Google Maps listing: https://maps.app.goo.gl/L4J8kdD6TN3PiPAa7
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 94400 00417
- Email: nagalawchambers@gmail.com
- Clients work directly with the advocate from first assessment through filing, hearing and compliance.

## Practice areas

- [Revenue & land](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/practice/revenue-land-lawyer-anantapur): ROR and Adangal corrections, mutations, patta disputes, encumbrance issues and land acquisition proceedings before revenue authorities.
- [Civil & contract](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/practice/civil-lawyer-anantapur): contract enforcement, recovery suits, specific performance, injunctions and declaratory relief.
- [Bail & criminal](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/practice/bail-criminal-lawyer-anantapur): regular and anticipatory bail, quashing petitions and criminal defence.
- [Family & partition](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/practice/family-partition-lawyer-anantapur): divorce, maintenance, custody, domestic violence remedies and property partition suits.
- [Consumer cases](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/practice/consumer-case-lawyer-anantapur): consumer complaints, deficiency of service and cheque bounce matters before statutory forums.

## Locations

- [Anantapur](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/locations/anantapur)
- [Dharmavaram](https://www.nagalawchambers.com/locations/dharmavaram)

## Forums covered

Tahsildar and MRO offices, Revenue Divisional Office (RDO) proceedings, District Court Anantapur, Family Court and Consumer Commissions, Sessions and Magistrate Courts, and the Andhra Pradesh High Court.

## Notes

- This site gives general information about the practice and is not legal advice. Contact the chambers for advice on a specific matter.
